The following events took place in '''3702 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] manages to cross the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]] and the [[Tyus Cluster/Legends|Tyus Cluster]]. She connects the [[Brentaal–Denon Route]] with the [[Dustig Trace]], blazing a new segment of the future [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. A portion later becomes the [[Itani Run]].
